title: Nonabelian composition factors of finite groups whose maximal subgroups are complemented: A solution to Kourovka Problem 18.68
description: A complete CFSG-conditional proof candidate for Kourovka Problem 18.68. It proves that the possible nonabelian composition factors of a finite group whose maximal subgroups are complemented are precisely PSL(2,7), PSL(2,11), and PSL(5,2). The repository includes the manuscript, proof audit, GAP 4.15.1/Table-of-Marks producers, pinned TomLib 1.2.11 certificates, and independent Python checkers. Independent external peer review remains pending.
